tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lo gsar gyi dus su dpal ldan lha mo'i tshes gtor 'bul tshul bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ rgyal ba'i yab gcig drag mo'i skur/ /mngon bzhengs gshin rje gshed kyi yum/ /lha mo nag mo re ma ti'i/ /zhabs pad gus mchod bdag cag skyongs/ /'dir lo gsar gyi dus su thog mar dpal ldan lha mo la tshes gtor 'bul tshul sngon ma de 'ga' zhig la 'don mi bde bar mthong nas/ bde ba'i ched du phye nas brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'di'i mngon rtogs nas sman rag 'bul ba'i tshul zhig 'byung ba 'di ni/ snga 'gyur theg pa nas brgyud pa'i lugs yin 'dug kyang*/ lha mo 'di'i ngo bo ni rgyud nas 'byung ba'i lha mo nag mo zhes bya ba ston pa nyid dang phyag na rdo rjes bsngags pa dang bcas te bstan srung thams cad kyi gtso mor bka' bsgos pa de nyid yin te/ lha mo de la sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i lha mo khyad par can gsum yod pa'i nang nas ma ti re ma ti zhes bya ba de lha mo 'di nyid yin par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad mgon po'i yum lha mo dang chos rgyal gy-i yum tsa muṇ+ḍi gnyis kyang lha mo 'di dang rgyud gcig go /des na mthu rtsal byin brlabs shin tu myur bas dbus gtsang gnyis su rgyal dbang dang paṇa chen snga phyi rnams kyis kyang bsten cing*/ bstan srung thams cad kyi gtso bor mdzad nas mchod pa'i rgyun phyogs 'dir dar ba bzhin du mchod gtor sogs 'bul tshul ni/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sku rten byin can phyag len bzhin bkram/ mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas rnams phul du byung bar bya zhing go rim dang bkod pa mdzes par byas te sgrub pa po rnams 'khod nas/ mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs sogs byin gyis brlab po/ /'dir 'ga' zhig ltar 'di nyin lha mo'i skyed chog zhig sngon du btang na 'di 'gal ba med kyang*/ nges par dgos pa ni min te/ 'dir rab 'byams rgyal ba mas lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs par mos pa de nyid la mchod rdzas rnams 'bul bar gsungs kyi/

skyed chog logs su bya bar ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rnam dbye shes dgos so/ /thog mar spyan 'dren pa ni/ bh+yoḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las la/ zhes pa nas/ myur du gshegs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ de nas rgyun du lha mo khyod bsten no/ /zhes pa nas/ dus bab da tshur spyon/ /e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo gdug can/ nas/ gdan la bzhugs/ za byed nag mo/ nas phyag bgyid do/ /sku gsum lhun grub ma yang brjod de/ mchod pa sngar byin gyis ma brlabs na 'dir byin rlabs byas nas/ ji ltar 'bul tshul ni/ bh+yoḥ bdag gi dngos bshams/ /zhes sogs kyis ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar kyis mchod/ de nas mchod do phyogs bcu zhes pa nas/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ skabs 'dir nang mchod bsdu na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ his kyang chog par snang ngo*/ /de nas/ phra mo spom po nas/ pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas nang mchod dang*/ chu dang ma 'dres nas rak+ta a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā his rak+ta 'bul/ de nas sha khrag la sogs nas/ bzhes su gsol/ zhes brjod cing*/ 'bul gtor la dmigs te/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags/ /nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kā li de bi nas kha kha khā hi zhes pa lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis 'bul/ skabs 'dir dpal lha dang tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs la gtor ma 'bul na spyan drangs te gzhung bzhin phul nas/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo dpag par dka' ba khyod/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /de nas rten rdzas la bya khyi nad rkyal ma gtogs 'bul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ sprin gyi shugs 'chang dre'u rkyang ser 'di/ /srin po'i thod sga nas yud kyis bskor ba'i bzhon pa 'di/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rten du 'bul/

/ 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i rten du 'bul/ rten las ma 'da' 'bem las ma g.yo bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rlung ltar nas 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur rta nag tshogs 'di dag dpal ldan= 'khor tshogs= rten las= sangs rgyas= rab brjid in+d+ra nī la'i nas/ g.yag rog zhol chen 'di/ dpal ldan= 'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin 'dod pa kun 'jo zhing*/ /char sprin lta bur mdzes pa'i rnga zhol can/ /rnam bkra dar gyi cod pan mang pos brgyan/ /nor 'dzin mdzes byed zhol mo'i chogs 'di dag/ /dpal ldan= 'jam pa'i spu tshogs char nas lug nag tshogs 'di dag /dpal ldan= 'jigs rung bdud sde'i nas go khrab 'di= dpal ldan= gang zhig btab pas nas/ mtshon cha 'bar ba 'di/ dpal ldan= dam nyams dgra bgegs nas nad thod 'di/ dpal ldan= gzhan yang sngo dmar mtshon gyi gru gu dang*/ re nag gos dang nas cha rkyen dam pa 'di/ dpal ldan= bh+yoḥ ri ltar spungs pa'i nas du mas brgyan pa 'di/ /dpal ldan= rdo rje'i thog dang nas mtshon cha 'di/ dpal ldan= nyi zla ri rab nas mchod sprin 'di/ /dpal ldan= /dus gsum rgyal ba'i nas bla med rten mchog 'di/ dpal ldan= 'khor= rten= sangs rgyas= de nas gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo la/ bstan pa srung ba'i cha rkyen du/ zhes pa nas= 'bad med lhun gyi grub par mdzod/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ skabs 'dir gtor chen 'bul bar bya ste/ sha khrag la sogs kyi mjug tu/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags nas drang te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kā li de wi nas khā hi'i bar nyung mtha' nyer lnga nas mang mtha' brgya'i bar brjod cing 'bul/ de nas mchod pa dang nang mchod kyang 'dod na phul chog /gtor rdzongs ni/ bh+yoḥ sha chen tshogs ni ri ltar spungs/ zhes pa nas/ longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma yang bsngo/

de nas bh+yoḥlha la dbang bskyur lha mo dpal 'bar ma/ dbang po brgya byin bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi gtso mo ste/ lha mo re ma ti la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu la dbang bsgyur/ /gtsug na rin chen bu mo nor 'dzin ma/ rol mtsho bdun gyi gnas kyi= /klu mo re ma= gnod sbyin dbang bsgyur= gang ba bzang mo'i bu mo gzi legs ma/ /bya dkar can gyi gnas kyi= /gnod sbyin re ma= /bdud la dbang bsgyur= re lte 'gong yag bu mo dri ldan ma/ /bdud mkhar rtse dgu'i gnas kyi= /bdud mo re ma= khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /nas 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi gzugs la 'dod khams gtso mo khyod/ /dre'u rta zhon nas dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug/be con nal thod dam pa'i rang rtags 'dzin/ /re lde'i stod g.yogs sprul gyi sham bu can/ /lte bar nyi shar gtsug na zla ba rgyas/ /'dod rgyu'i mchog sbyin dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma/ lha mo re ma ti la bstod par bgyi/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /zhes pas bstod la/ de nas thams cad phangs te/ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings dbang phyug ma gcig bdud kyi yum/ zhes pa nas/ bya khyi lce spyang la sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ /yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas/ /dgra bo'i srog la dbang byed bshan pa'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces brjaud de gtor ma byang shar mtshams su gshegs la/ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas= /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa= /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud= /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems= /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por gtong*/ /da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs gnyen por bzhes/ /'khor rnams skyong zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/

/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlags pa dang*/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di khyod kyis sgrubs/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis skyongs yun ring zhabs brtan shog /zhes pa dang*/ de nas slar gdan la 'khod de/ mnga' gsol bya ba ni/ bh+yoḥ rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /bde chen chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig kyang*/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las sgrub mdzad lha mo khyod/ /bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs su mnga' gsol lo/ /lhan cig skyes dngos bde chen nam mkha'i dang*/ /grangs med gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba can/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i yum khyod rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /spangs rtogs dbyer med zhir gyur dam pa'i chos/ /rig grol mthar phyin 'phags tshogs kun gyi gtso/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum du mnga'= /'od srung bstan pa'i mjug tu lha mo khyod/ /nyi ma'i gnyen dang smon lam lhan cig pas/ /zhing 'dir thub bstan srung dang spel mdzad pa'i/ /bka' srung kun gyi gtso mor= /zhing skyes lhan cig skyes dang sngags skyes kyi/ /gnas gsum mkha' gro'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /thogs med dngos grub char 'bebs lha mo khyod/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mor= khyod ni srid gsum ma lus kun gyi bdag /'dod khams dbang bsgyur sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i srung ma'i gtso/ /snang srid kun gyi bdag mor= /bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas bcas/ /kun gyi srung mar mnga' gsol gnyer gtad kyi/ /deng nas bzung te byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel zhig

/de nas yig brgya brjod dam min kyang ma rnyed yongs su zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ 'dir ni gzugs dang zhes sogs kyis rten la bstim par bya'o/ /bkra shis ni/ /bh+yoḥ dran pa tsam gyis dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams dang*/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rab zhi chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ thabs mang sprul pas bstan pa srung mdzad cing*/ /sgrub pa po rnams bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i= /chos bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag skyong ba dang*/ bstan dgra dam nyams phye mar 'thags pa la/ /nam yang g.yel ba med pa'i 'phrin las can/ /gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i=/ /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun grub pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi= /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i/ /zhes pa nas/ bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang 'ga' zhig gis bskul pas rkyen byas te gzhan la'ang phan snyam pa'i bsam pas gzhung na kha 'phangs shing thor rnams yod pa rnams blangs te 'don bde bar bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni dka' bcu 'jam dbyangs don yod do/ /maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ lo gsar gyi dus su dpal ldan lha mo'i tshes gtor 'bul tshul bzhugs/ - PAGE 160-- PAGE 159- -PAGE 154-
